item.description: The Signal constructor does not properly handle complex reset values like dictionaries for StructLayout and UnionLayout objects. The error occurs when trying to pass reset values like {"a": 1, "b": 2} to Signal constructors with layout shapes.

contract.description: Signal constructor should properly validate and process reset values for layout-based shapes, supporting complex reset values like dictionaries for StructLayout and UnionLayout.
contract.input: reset parameter should accept complex reset values for layout-based shapes
contract.output: Signal should correctly process complex reset values using the layout's _convert_to_int method
contract.exception: Should raise TypeError with clear message for invalid reset values

item.description: The View.__getattr__ method does not properly handle reserved field names and provides inadequate error messages for missing fields. It raises AttributeError with generic messages instead of helpful suggestions.

contract.description: View.__getattr__ should properly handle reserved field names (those starting with underscore) and provide helpful error messages for missing fields with suggestions for similar names.
contract.input: Access to reserved field names should be restricted to indexing, missing field names should trigger helpful error messages
contract.output: Reserved fields should raise AttributeError with clear message, missing fields should suggest similar names
contract.exception: Should raise AttributeError with appropriate messages for reserved and missing fields

item.description: The Signal.__getattr__ method does not support attribute access for Views with layouts, causing "Signal has no attribute" errors when accessing fields on Signals constructed with layout shapes.

contract.description: Signal.__getattr__ should delegate attribute access to Views when the Signal has a layout shape, allowing struct-like attribute access for Signals with layout-based shapes.
contract.input: Attribute access on Signals with layout shapes should be delegated to View attribute access
contract.output: Attribute access should return View fields or raise appropriate errors
contract.exception: Should raise AttributeError with clear message when attribute does not exist

item.description: The View.__getitem__ method does not properly handle array layouts with dynamic indexing and provides incorrect error messages for wrong types of indices.

contract.description: View.__getitem__ should properly validate and handle array layouts with dynamic indexing, providing clear error messages for invalid index types.
contract.input: Indexing with values on array layouts should be validated properly
contract.output: Should allow dynamic indexing on array layouts and raise TypeError with appropriate message for invalid cases
contract.exception: Should raise TypeError with clear message for invalid array indexing scenarios

item.description: The Layout._convert_to_int method does not properly handle ShapeCastable objects in reset value processing, causing TypeError issues with reset values.

contract.description: Layout._convert_to_int should properly handle ShapeCastable objects with custom const methods when processing reset values.
contract.input: Reset values should be processed for ShapeCastable objects with custom const methods
contract.output: Should convert reset values using ShapeCastable's const method when available
contract.exception: Should raise TypeError with clear message for invalid reset values
